summary.description: WoW Forever preserves classic pet mechanics with normalized base speeds, native passive swing-speed inheritance, 18 pet families, the new Fox family, and 9 brand new or reworked family abilities.

families.name: Bat

newAbility.name: Sonic Blast
newAbility.desc: Emits a piercing shriek, inflicting 33 to 39 Nature damage (Rank 2) and increasing the casting time of all spells by 60% for 30 sec.

families.highlight: Potent anti-caster pet; 60% cast slow shuts down enemy healers and casters in PvP.

families.name: Bear

newAbility.name: Swipe & Dash
newAbility.desc: Swipe swipes 3 nearby enemies for cleave damage every 5 seconds. Bears also learn Dash for rapid target closing.

families.highlight: Unmatched multi-target tank; Swipe cleaves 3 targets and holds dungeon pack agro.

families.name: Bird of Prey

newAbility.name: Mine!
newAbility.desc: Grabs an enemy's weapon with its talons, causing 20 to 24 damage and physically disarming them for 4 sec.

families.highlight: Disarm specialist; strips melee weapons from warriors and rogues to neutralize burst.

families.name: Boar

newAbility.name: Charge Rework
newAbility.desc: Charges an enemy, immobilizes it for 1 sec, and adds up to +204 melee attack power (Rank 3) to the boar's next attack.

families.highlight: Omnivorous levelling king; eats anything, root-charges targets, and has high natural armor.

families.name: Carrion Bird

newAbility.name: Demoralizing Screech
newAbility.desc: Blasts an enemy for damage and lowers the melee attack power of all enemies in melee range by 111 (Rank 2) for 30 sec.

families.highlight: AoE debuff utility; Screech reduces entire monster packs' melee damage by 111 AP.

families.name: Cat

newAbility.name: Prowl & Lethal Speed
newAbility.desc: Stealth ambush with +50% opener damage bonus. Broken Tooth's 1.0s swing speed inflicts severe spell-pushback.

families.highlight: Maximum single-target damage output; essential for Marksmanship & BM raid DPS.

families.name: Crab

newAbility.name: Pinch & Dash
newAbility.desc: Pinches enemy legs for 32 to 36 damage (Rank 2) and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.

families.highlight: Massive +13% armor rating combined with an on-demand 50% hamstring pin.

families.name: Crocolisk

newAbility.name: Dismember (Mortal Strike)
newAbility.desc: Viciously bites enemy appendages, reducing healing effectiveness by 50% for 10 sec on a 6-second cooldown.

families.highlight: PvP meta-definer; keeps 100% uptime on 50% healing reduction without requiring an Arms warrior.

families.name: Fox

newAbility.name: Trickster's Dance
newAbility.desc: Increases pet's chance to Dodge by 50% and decreases attack intervals by 30% for 12 sec.

families.highlight: Brand new pet family added to WoW Forever! Extreme defensive evasion and rapid burst attacks.

families.name: Gorilla

newAbility.name: Thunderstomp Rework
newAbility.desc: Shakes the ground with thundering force, dealing 53 to 61 Nature damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

families.highlight: Area-of-effect threat burst; synergizes with Hunter traps and multi-pull dungeons.

families.name: Hyena
families.highlight: Well-rounded scavenger beast with high agility and Dash mobility.

families.name: Raptor
families.highlight: Pure offensive power with +10% damage bonus alongside Cats.

families.name: Scorpid
families.highlight: Scorpid Poison stacks nature DoT to protect Viper Sting from dispel in PvP.

families.name: Spider
families.highlight: High damage ambush predator with accessible tames throughout early leveling zones.

families.name: Tallstrider
families.highlight: Dust Cloud reduces enemy hit chance; vegetarian diet makes feeding very affordable.

families.name: Turtle
families.highlight: Ultimate tanking pet; Shell Shield reduces all damage taken by 50% for 12 sec.

families.name: Wind Serpent
families.highlight: Ranged Nature damage attacks that ignore physical armor and hit targets through obstacles.

families.name: Wolf
families.highlight: Furious Howl buffs physical damage of party members; top raid support companion.
